parties: <cite index="27-1">The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America and HCL Technologies Limited (HCLTech)</cite>
headline: <cite index="2-2,2-3">HCLTech acquires the India Global Capability Centre of Guardian Life Insurance Company of America for $10.5 million, a 100% equity stake acquisition of Guardian India Operations Private Limited</cite>
sum: <cite index="1-5,1-6">Guardian divested its stake in Guardian India Operations Private Limited, Guardian's Technology & Operations Global Capability Centre (GCC) based in India, to HCL Technologies Limited. Nearly 2,000 Guardian India employees have transitioned to HCLTech under the deal, with HCLTech establishing a dedicated Strategic Business Unit focused exclusively on supporting Guardian.</cite>
implication: GCC captive-to-service-provider transition: the structuring precedent demonstrates how a large US multinational can divest its India technology center at modest valuation (₹101 cr for ₹578.8 cr FY26 revenue) by bundling it with a long-term strategic MSA-a model increasingly used by global enterprises to drive AI/digital transformation while offloading captive cost.
detail: <cite index="2-4,2-5">Nearly 2,000 highly skilled employees from Chennai and Gurugram centres will transition directly to HCLTech, forming a brand new dedicated business unit specifically focused on serving Guardian. The major acquisition extends an existing technology partnership into a long-term seven-year master services agreement centred on artificial intelligence-led modernisation.</cite> <cite index="44-10,44-11">Guardian India Operations was incorporated on 5 March 2002 and operates in India as Guardian's global capability centre. It reported revenue of ₹578.8 crore in FY2026 (as per unaudited financials), compared with ₹483.2 crore in FY2025 and ₹493.5 crore in FY2024.</cite>

structure.novel: <cite index="36-7">HCLTech and Guardian transitioned from their initial AI technology transformation partnership announced in January 2026 to a significantly larger, expanded seven-year strategic agreement.</cite> The novelty lies in coupling the GCC acquisition with an AI-centric 7-year MSA covering AI Force platform deployment and agentic AI capabilities-transforming a captive center divestiture into a bundled strategic partnership with embedded IP co-creation.
